description: Election Commission - Declare that D. P. Jeyaransan  and L. Tharsiba as members of the Jaffana Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local municipal council (Jaffna Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local government positions, including the declaration of selected members to fill vacancies caused by resignations. This falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) as it pertains to electoral matters and council member appointments.
